team_customers_desc: Manage the people behind your business. From employee access to customer loyalty, everything is scoped to your store.
customers_desc: Manage contact details, purchase history, and loyalty information for your clients.
users_desc: Control employee accounts, login credentials, and personal access settings for the system.
roles_desc: Define permissions and access levels for different user groups (e.g., Manager, Cashier, Admin).
time_clock_desc: Tracks and manages cashiers' work hours, including clock-ins/outs, and hour adjustments.
